job.job_description:
This is a remote position.
AI Developer / AI Engineer Agentic AI, LLM Predictive Analytics
Job Summary
We are looking for an AI Developer with hands-on experience in Agentic AI systems, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Predictive AI/ML models. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions including autonomous agents, chatbots, predictive models, and AI automation tools to support business operations and product development.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and deploy Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.
Build applications using Large Language Models (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, etc.)
Design and implement Predictive AI / Machine Learning models
Develop AI chatbots, automation tools, and AI assistants
Work on RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems
Integrate AI solutions with web applications, CRMs, and enterprise systems
Fine-tune and optimize LLM models
Work with structured and unstructured data
Deploy AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Collaborate with business and product teams to identify AI use cases
Required Skills
Python
Machine Learning (Regression, Classification, Clustering)
Predictive Modeling
LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace)
LangChain / CrewAI / AutoGen
Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma)
RAG Architecture
Prompt Engineering
API Development
Data Processing (Pandas, NumPy)
Git / Version Control
Preferred Skills
Fine-tuning LLM models
AI Agents / Multi-Agent Systems
NLP (Natural Language Processing)
MLOps
Docker / Kubernetes
Cloud AI Services
Knowledge Graphs
AI Automation Workflows
Experience Required
36 Years in AI/ML development OR 2+ Years specifically in LLM / Generative AI / Agentic AI
Education
B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MS in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or related field
Job Type: Full time
